proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling on, the coordinator sentinel run re-takes a pending check baseline for each item remeasureCandidates returns, up to the registered runner count, through the ordered editItem move with the item's unchanged check.

cli.io-commands-sentinel.remeasure-reque.why: Without it checks frozen before the ceiling exist stay unmeasured, or a pass floods the runners with more baselines than they have slots.

proves.claim: When a remeasure baseline completes, the item baseline records its seconds, and a later claim of it follows checkVerdict on the measured time.

cli.io-commands-sentinel.remeasure-secon.why: Without it a remeasured check never gains the time the ceiling judges, and is requested again on every pass.

proves.claim: With claim.checkCeiling off, the default, sentinel run offers no baseline.

cli.io-commands-sentinel.remeasure-off.why: Without it the default machine would start remeasuring every old check the moment a pass ran.
